capabilities: show markers on clickable UI elements
click elements by pressing the matching keys
customize CSS selectors used to find clickable elements
change the font size of markers
disambiguation: Not a Vim editing mode for the editor; it only lets keyboard shortcuts click interface elements.
extras: The Showcase section appears empty in the README; usage is only documented through the feature list and version history.
problem: Obsidian's buttons and clickable interface elements normally require mouse clicks, with no built-in keyboard-driven way to interact with them.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Vimium extension for Chrome.

summary: Keyboard shortcut plugin that overlays letter markers on clickable UI elements so they can be activated without the mouse.
